title: EMG: myopathy
summary: Small, short motor unit potentials in a diseased muscle.
description: The same muscle (tibialis anterior), recorded in the same way, in a man with a myopathy: an inflammatory disease of the muscle fibres (polymyositis). Each motor unit has lost muscle fibres, so its potentials are small and short, and often have many phases; many units have to fire even for a gentle contraction. Compare it with the healthy muscle at the same time scale.
look_for: The size and length of the motor unit potentials, compared with the healthy muscle
How crowded the recording is during the contraction

channels.name: EMG (tibialis anterior)
channels.about: a concentric needle electrode in the muscle

subject.notes: A myopathy from long-standing polymyositis, treated with steroids and low-dose methotrexate, as the database records.
